description: This line plot illustrates the reliability scores of different model ensembles as a function of cost. The x-axis represents "Cost," scaled linearly from 30 to 8, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents "Reliability Score," scaled linearly from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The plot contains three lines: a blue line with circular markers labeled "3-Model Ensemble," a red line with circular markers labeled "2-Model Ensemble," and a yellow line with circular markers representing a single model. The blue line starts at a reliability score of approximately 60 at a cost of 30 and increases to approximately 88 at a cost of 8. The red line starts at a reliability score of approximately 62 at a cost of 30 and increases to approximately 87 at a cost of 8. The yellow line starts at a reliability score of approximately 88 at a cost of 30 and decreases to approximately 60 at a cost of 8. The blue and red lines are nearly parallel and lie above the yellow line for most of the cost range, with the blue line slightly above the red line at higher costs. The yellow line intersects both the blue and red lines at a cost of approximately 4, where its reliability score is approximately 72.
